notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/devstral-2-25-12; og:url also lists /models/devstral-2-25-12). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, modalities tooltips, features, weights, deprecation), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header, modality tooltips Text input and Text output, Weights table Parameters/Active 123, context 256k, Modified MIT). Blog link on the page and mistral.ai/news/devstral-2-vibe-cli were not used; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. Headless Chrome could not resolve DNS here; text.txt was built from curl HTML + RSC payloads. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup. Seed also has Devstral Small 2 (24B) but this card's HF/weights row is Devstral-2-123B-Instruct-2512 only.
